brief:
Israeli forces and settlers launched at least 467 attacks on Palestinian communities across the occupied West Bank over the past week, Middle East Eye reported. The attacks spanned multiple Palestinian towns and neighborhoods, involving what the outlet described as "violence, dispossession, and destruction" directed at civilian populations and property.

The reported assault marks an escalation in the frequency of coordinated operations by Israeli military units and settlers against Palestinians in the territory. The seven-day period saw attacks distributed across numerous communities, suggesting a widespread campaign rather than isolated incidents. Documented assaults included both armed confrontations and what observers characterized as settler-led property destruction and land seizures affecting Palestinian residents.
